architecture_summary: React SPA. React Router for nav. Three pages: catalog, detail, checkout. Shared car data via src/data/cars.js. Tailwind styling assumed.

tickets.title: Car data module
tickets.description: Static array of luxury cars: id, name, brand, price/day, image, specs, description. Export getAll and getById.
acceptance_criteria: Each car has id, name, brand, pricePerDay, image, specs object, description

tickets.title: Catalog page
tickets.description: Grid of car cards. Each card shows image, name, brand, price/day, View Details link to /cars/:id. Hero header with title.
acceptance_criteria: Each card links to /cars/:id via React Router Link

tickets.title: Vehicle detail page
tickets.description: Read :id from route params. Show large image, full specs, description, price. Reserve button links to /checkout/:id.
acceptance_criteria: Uses useParams to load car via getCarById
Shows 404-style message if car not found
Displays image, name, brand, price, specs list, description

tickets.title: Reservation checkout page
tickets.description: Form: full name, email, phone, pickup date, return date, pickup location. Show selected car summary and total price (days * pricePerDay). Submit shows confirmation state.
acceptance_criteria: Native HTML5 validation on required fields (name, email, phone, dates)
On submit shows success confirmation without page reload

tickets.title: App shell and routing
tickets.description: BrowserRouter with routes: / -> Catalog, /cars/:id -> CarDetail, /checkout/:id -> Checkout. Top nav bar with brand logo and Catalog link.
acceptance_criteria: Three routes wired to correct components
Persistent nav header across all pages
